_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Arthur Livingston (1883-1944): Blasco Ibáñez's Mayflower, Quiroga's South American Jungle Tales (1922), Farrère's The House of the Secret and Montessori's Elementary Material (1917). Printings before 1931 only. His Torrent, with Isaac Goldberg, is on isaac-goldberg_shelf.json. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 25); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
